title: Memoir Chrome, the first fitted film
body: Memoir Chrome was fitted on the chart's 47 patches (CC). A second chart, hand-held over grass in daylight, checked that the fit held away from the frame it was fitted on. Its first recipe, Still Air 100, came the same day.

images.alt: A hand-held colour chart over grass: the camera's JPEG next to Memoir Chrome.
images.caption: DSCF6532: the camera's JPEG in CC (left) and Memoir Chrome on the same RAW (right).
